context: Mei and Aoi react to a surprising trend.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (驚い/激しい/流行/とっても/お知らせ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: この新しい流行、知ってる?
lines.en: Do you know this new trend?
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん、広まる速さに驚いたの。
lines.en: Yeah, I was surprised how fast it spread.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: とっても、人気になったよね。
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 競争も、激しくなってるみたい。
lines.en: The competition seems to be getting fierce.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 店にも、お知らせを貼ろうかな。
lines.en: Maybe I'll put up a notice in the shop.
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: とっても良いアイデアだと思う。
lines.en: I think that's a really good idea.
lines.style: warm woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 流行の激しさには、驚くばかりだよ。
lines.en: I'm just amazed at the intensity of trends.
lines.style: lively barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お知らせ、私も手伝うね。
lines.en: I'll help with the notice too.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
